text:
anya: Quick check — onboarding 'lucida-13b' model. Where are the canonical weights stored? HF says 'lucida/lucida-13b' but registry mirror path unclear, and CI checksum failed earlier today.
marcos: I pushed a shadow mirror to s3://rw-artifacts/models/lucida/13b/sha256-9f2a... but that was from the HF snapshot. Which HF commit/tag are we pinning?
rachel: HF tag is v2026-03-15. We validated model card. CI error: manifest checksum mismatch on shard 0001.
anya: exact error?
rachel: From artifact-sync job: `Checksum mismatch for shard-0001.bin: expected 3b7f12.. got 6c9e44..`. Job retried twice.
jonathan: I pulled the HF files locally and ran `sha256sum` — local matches HF but not the S3 mirror. Likely an incomplete copy or multipart ETag issue.
marcos: Multipart upload changes ETag. We should store a canonical sha256 digest in the manifest file instead of relying on S3 ETag. I updated manifest draft with `digest: sha256:3b7f12...`.
anya: Good call. eng-infra, can we add a preflight check to compare manifest.digest to computed sha256 on uploaded object?
eng-infra-bot: @anya created ticket INFRA-1221: add artifact preflight checksum verification and multipart-safe upload verifier.
ml-bot: Note: tokenizer for lucida-13b uses special BOS token 50256 and includes an extra pad token at id 1. Downstream tokenization test in evals failed on padding slicing (off-by-one).
jonathan: Tokenizer quirk acknowledged — add a small compatibility shim: when loading tokenizer, set `pad_token='<|pad|>'` and call `tokenizer.post_process()` in our loader. Will draft PR.
marcos: Permissions: the s3 path is in a restricted bucket; devex role doesn't have read access. Rachel, can you confirm which IAM role should be granted read/list for model onboarding flows?
rachel: Grant `redwood-model-sync` role read-only to s3://rw-artifacts/models/lucida/* and to kms key alias/rdw-models. I'll file IAM change; ETA EOD.
anya: For the manifest, besides digest, we should also include `origin: huggingface://lucida/lucida-13b@v2026-03-15`, `files: [shard-0000.bin, shard-0001.bin, tokenizer.json]`, and `variant: fp16`. Marcos — can we have the registry accept that schema?
marcos: Yes, registry accepts those fields. I'm adding a small validation rule: `origin` must match `^huggingface://` or `^s3://` and `digest` must be sha256 prefixed. I'll update schema today.
jonathan: Code review ping for the tokenizer shim: PR #421 in eng-ml. Could reviewers take a look? small change in model_loaders/lucida_loader.py.
anya: Also, CI presign TTL for artifact downloads is 15m currently — for large shards, downloads sometimes exceed TTL and presign fails mid-transfer. Can we bump presign TTL for model artifacts to 1h?
eng-infra-bot: @anya noted. Created ticket INFRA-1222 to evaluate presign TTL and multipart resume strategy.
marcos: Temp mitigation: use `aws s3 cp --expected-size` with multipart resume and `--part-size 50MB` in our sync script. Example snippet:```
aws s3 cp s3://rw-artifacts/models/lucida/13b/shard-0001.bin ./ --part-size 50MB
sha256sum shard-0001.bin
```
rachel: After IAM update I'll re-run artifact-sync and validate. If checksum still mismatches, we'll re-mirror from HF with forced copy.
anya: Last ask — whoever verifies, please post final manifest and the s3 path here. Also include the final sha256 for each shard. Small checklist:
- [ ] manifest with origin + digest
- [ ] tokenizer shim PR merged
- [ ] IAM read to redwood-model-sync
- [ ] presign TTL ticket owned

marcos: I'll drop the manifest (draft) and expected sha256s here once infra confirms upload: s3://rw-artifacts/models/lucida/13b/manifest.json
jonathan: Reviewing PR now; will try to get approval in next hour.
ml-bot: Regression eval queued for lucida-13b once PR merged: EVAL-789.
rachel: IAM change submitted (request #A-5678). If approved, I will trigger re-sync and post results.
anya: thanks all :thumbsup:
marcos: quick note — if anyone needs to debug multipart vs singlepart, run `aws s3api head-object --bucket rw-artifacts --key models/lucida/13b/shard-0001.bin` and check `Metadata` and `ETag`.
jonathan: confirmed head-object shows ETag with hyphens -> multipart. We'll use registry digest as source of truth.
anya: closing loop — please update this thread with final sha256s and manifest link when done.
